messages:
tina_sales: FYI - NovaSys POC intermittent failure. They use function-calls + JSON mode to ingest inventory. Sometimes stream ends with truncated array or escaped quotes and client throws 'Unexpected end of JSON input'. Also saw 429s during their rush test. They want Dedicated pricing + confirmation on HSM & EU data residency in de-central. Can eng/security triage?

marc_eng: can you paste a redacted raw chunk and headers? Which model?

tina_sales: redacted chunk below (from their DEBUG logs):
```
{"tool":"inventory_extract","items":[{"sku":"B2","name":"Thing"}, {"sku":"B3","name":"Thing2"}]}
\u001b

parse error at pos 178
```
Headers: `x-rw-model: redwood-tools-1.2-q6`, `x-client-id: novasys-21`

ada_oncall: 429s likely due to 10 parallel workers hitting /v1/stream. Can we add them to a canary and bump burst tokens temporarily?

ken_ml: q6 fast path sometimes appends kernel footer bytes on flush under burst. Two fixes: 1) stream assembler sanitizer to trim non-utf8 suffixes and validate final char (} or ]) before parse; 2) fallback wrapper option that returns {"_rw_tool_malformed":true,"raw_b64":"..."} when sanitizer removed bytes. I'll open a small PR.

marc_eng: agree. Implement sanitizer + opt-in base64 fallback behind route flag `tool_stream_fallback=base64`. Also add streaming-metrics tag so we can find affected requests.

olga_security: on SQ: they ask about HSM-backed keys and residency in eu-central-1 (de-central). Private supports customer-managed KMS/HSM; Hosted Dedicated can be provisioned in eu-central-1 under enterprise agreement and KMS addendum. 7-year retention is heavy; recommend export/archival option or extended retention add-on. I'll draft the response.

ryan_salesops: ballpark Dedicated for their expected load (45k tokens/day with spikes) is ~Mk/mo, min 4 GPUs reserved. I'll pull finance for an official quote and an accelerated procurement.

deploy-bot: [deploy 2179.4] stream-sanitize-fallback built and queued for canary. CI: \u2705 unit, \u2705 integration.

ada_oncall: added novasys-21 to canary routing and temporarily increased per-client burst token limit to 190 for repro window. Monitoring: https://console.redwood/integrations/novasys-21/streams (alerts set).

tina_sales: customer will repro tonight 21:30 UTC. If we can show clean JSON + stable throughput they will sign. Please update after canary. Thanks!
